info.title: Vouch API
info.description: Two-sided marketplace: clients post briefs/send direct offers, creators bid/negotiate, both consent to terms before escrow funds, then draft -> approve -> live -> payout. Generated from the actual implementation in `src/` — every schema/example here is what the code returns, not a re-statement of the original spec. See `API.md` in the repo for the same content with prose explanations of every gap found between the original spec and the design files.
